name: Rimegrass Blessing: Thorn Frost
description:
Roll Phase: Roll 2 Cryo Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
End Phase: Deal 2 Piercing DMG to opposing character(s) affected by Cryo, then remove their Cryo application.
